name: Joyoung Co.,Ltd
summary: Joyoung Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of small home appliances and kitchen utensils in China and internationally. It offers soy-milk makers, induction and rice cookers, air fryers, and food processors. It also engages in storage, processing, and sales of grain; and technical consulting of appliances and kitchen utensils. Joyoung Co.,Ltd was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Jinan, China. Joyoung Co.,Ltd is a subsidiary of Shanghai Li Hung Enterprise Management Co., Ltd.
